<div class="card-body">
'''Affect Mind''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">幻惑</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">1フォース消費し、ジェダイのキャラクターに配備する。ダーク・ジェダイが同じロケーションにいない限り、その場所の相手の合計能力値は、−2される。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
<span lang="ja">「今のはなんだ？」ジェダイの力の一つ、「幻惑」は、相手の気をそらして遠ざけ、無用な戦いを避ける技である。</span>

<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Bewilderment.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on a Jedi character. Unless a Dark Jedi is at the same location, the opponent's total ability at that location is reduced by 2.

'''Lore:''' “What was that?” One of the Jedi powers, “bewilderment,” is a technique that distracts opponents and draws them away, avoiding unnecessary battles.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says a Jedi character, without the English restriction “one of your Jedi.” It checks whether a Dark Jedi is at the same location; the English uses “also present.”<ref name="photo" /><ref name="english-printing">[[:File:Premiere-L-affectmind-decipher-archive.gif|Affect Mind English printed face]].</ref>

<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Affect Mind]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="photo">[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector gallery], PSA; [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/160356852/zqzBF6V8jkufoXH85w-rog.jpg Affect Mind original photograph].</ref>
